name: Biological Sciences PhD
summary: Biological sciences doctorate with first-year rotations for students who are not directly recruited into a faculty laboratory.
detailsNote: Official fall deadline is annual and undated. Rotation and direct-laboratory recruitment routes coexist; no universal advance mentor requirement inferred.

publishedDeadlines.label: Domestic and international fall application
publishedDeadlines.note: Month/day only; no Spring/Summer intake and no confirmed Fall 2027 countdown.

applicationFee.note: No fee waiver confirmed on opened programme/central sources.

english.note: PTE 68. Programme lists waiver possibility but does not establish its criteria on opened profile. No new TOEFL-scale conversion inferred; confirm current scale and exemption with admissions.

documents: Official transcripts from all attended institutions, including degree conferral
Original-language records and institution/ATA-certified word-for-word English translations
Approximately 500-word statement with research interests and prospective Biology faculty names
requirements.note: Bachelor or master entrants accepted. Transcript evaluation required if only one lifetime transcript issued, and may be required case-by-case for any international applicant, at applicant expense. International graduates must provide graduation certificates. Two academic or supervisory references. General central GPA guidance remains typical, not a programme-specific cutoff.
